validity_findings.finding: Producer correctly diagnoses root cause: parameterized overhead is ${varname} (varname.length+3 chars: '$','{','}') plus varname length. For short concrete values (1-3 digit numbers: '1','10','books' etc vs slots id/userId/limit/page/category/minPrice/maxPrice), overhead dominates, causing -5% to -9% penalty. This is a structural property disclosed in validity_notes not a bug. Template savings require concrete value longer than varname+3.

claim_ceiling: Resolve/bind pipeline survives narrowly: manually-registered parameterized mechanisms with 1-3 slots (templates https://api.example.com/users/${id}, https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/comments?postId=${id}, https://api.example.com/posts?userId=${userId}&limit=${limit}, https://api.example.com/users/${userId}/posts?page=${page}, https://api.example.com/products?category=${category}&minPrice=${minPrice}&maxPrice=${maxPrice}) resolve EXECUTABLE with correct bound_action when required_slots satisfied and UNKNOWN when missing, and _bind substitutes correctly for 1-3 vars; kernel regression 3/3 intact. Token economics hypothesis FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING for tested regime: under tiktoken cl100k_base encoding of action_template JSON (method+url, sort_keys), parameterized representation uses MORE tokens than literal for 0/5 patterns (19->20,23->24,25->26,23->25,31->34), mean -6.4% (threshold 15%), monotonic increase false (-9.68% < -4.81%). Penalty grows with slot count because ${var} overhead (varname+3) exceeds short numeric values (1-3 chars). Ceiling bounded to synthetic deterministic short-value GET URLs with api.example.com/jsonplaceholder, single confidence 0.9, tiktoken only, isolated intents (no literal+param competition). No evidence for long-value savings (UUIDs/slugs), LLM tokenizer differences, amortized mechanism deduplication, PUT/POST, cross-site, noisy browser or LLM-distilled induction. Parent 68 vs 96 (29.17% savings) single-point remains unreplicated and should not be cited as established. C-PARAM-INHERIT remains EXPERIMENTAL (pipeline validated, economics falsified for this regime); C-PRODUCT-ECON remains HYPOTHESIS with negative token-component evidence; no promotion to product.
